_readme: Real photography for the site. .github/workflows/photos.yml downloads each at 3840px and commits it to public/images/photos/ (CI cannot reach unsplash.com page ids, so use 'cdn' for Unsplash or 'pexels' for Pexels). 'file' = a local photo instead. Unsplash and Pexels licences: free for commercial use, attribution optional.

mumbai.alt: The South Mumbai skyline across the Arabian Sea under monsoon clouds

sealink.alt: The Bandra–Worli Sea Link in Mumbai with fishing boats in the foreground

desk.alt: A team reviewing charts and notes around a desk, seen from above

nyc.alt: Aerial view of Manhattan with the Empire State Building

centralpark.alt: Central Park and the Manhattan skyline from above
